Her full name is Misato Katsuragi.
Age 29. Part of the operations department of the special agency, NERV.
She seems optimistic and carefree at first, but there's a stern side to her.

lines.text:
Come here, Pen Pen.
That's a good boy!
I look forward to working with you until we return.
If it's not too much trouble, can you arrange for a freezer?

This here is Pen Pen.
Please be nice to each other.
I wonder if Shinji is okay?
The beer is lovely here.

Are you going to keep me waiting?
Okay, that's fine... for now.
Is it all right if I look around?

So this is the Outpost...
Incredible.
This place actually has everything...

There's even a bar!
Amazing!

I'm Misato Katsuragi, and I work for NERV.
You can simply call me Misato.
What scientific laws are governing this?

I don't quite understand how this all works,
but thank you for the support.
Ritsuko wouldn't believe this even if I told her.
Thank you. I'll be sure to put it to good use.
I owe you quite a lot, you know.
Uh... What exactly is a Darling for a Day?

So the Ark is the last bastion of humanity?
That's something it shares with Nerv.
As fellow Commanders, let's do our due diligence.
It can be tough to keep the children in line.
Combat isn't my specialty... but I'll go with you.
Understood.
It's that side.
commence operation.
Proceed according to the operational plans!
... Let's go!
I'm counting on you!
Reloading!
Cover me!
Sorry! Stay strong, everyone!
Let's get this done!
Prepare for launch! Launch!
Focus all firepower on target!
We did it!
Great!
Gotcha!
Watch out...!
Ugh...!
Keuk...!
... Sorry, it's up to you now.
Whew... I need a drink.
